From the first time a candidate hears Movember's name through to the moment they're ready for whatever the mission asks of them next, this role shapes that experience. It's a genuinely global role. High influencing ability, with a proven track record of building trust and shifting thinking with stakeholders at all levels, including executive leadership. Confidence representing an organisation externally as a brand and employee ambassador. Knowledge of employment legislation in the UK, Ireland, Canada, the United States, or New Zealand. Recognition as a thought leader in talent or HR through speaking, writing, podcasting, or community building. Experience deploying AI or automation within a talent or people function. If you’ve got the relevant skills and the right attitude, let nothing stand in your way of firing off your application.
